an.demo.legend.en: Demo analytics, labelled estimated. Rates show numerator and denominator; unobserved values are unavailable, never zero.
an.demo.legend.zh: 演示数据，标注为估算。比率显示分子与分母；未观测值显示为不可用，绝不记为零。

ws.catalog.sub.en: Every title, its TikTok status and its advertising status. Open a title for its sections.
ws.catalog.sub.zh: 所有作品及其 TikTok 状态与广告状态。打开作品查看各分区。

rd.resultsSub.en: Compare each ad with the opening-retention and click-through benchmarks. Click-through rate is clicks divided by impressions.
rd.resultsSub.zh: 将每条广告的开场留存率和点击率与基准对比。点击率等于点击次数除以展示次数。

rd.benchWhy.en: Meeting both benchmarks is a signal to consider another test. It does not establish profitability.
rd.benchWhy.zh: 两项基准均达标，可作为继续测试的参考，不代表已实现盈利。

rd.decideSub.en: From the table above. Not a prediction.

rd.winnerLine.en: Ad {n} met both: hook hold {hold}%, CTR {ctr}%.
rd.winnerLine.zh: 广告 {n} 两项达标：开场留存 {hold}%，点击率 {ctr}%。

rd.missedLine.zh: 广告 {n} {what}未达标：开场留存 {hold}%，点击率 {ctr}%。

rd.nextSub.en: Creates round {n} as a new campaign. Nothing launches until it is approved again.
rd.nextSub.zh: 创建第 {n} 轮新广告活动。再次批准前不会投放。

rd.scaleHint.en: Draft a new ${budget} round (3× this round), with the same audience and Ad {ad} as the creative direction.
rd.scaleHint.zh: 创建预算 ${budget} 的新一轮草稿（本轮的 3 倍），受众不变，以广告 {ad} 为创意方向。

rd.moreHint.en: Same ${budget}, new ads on the best hypothesis.
rd.moreHint.zh: 预算不变（${budget}），围绕最佳假设制作新广告。

rd.retryHint.zh: 预算不变（${budget}），新广告、新假设。

rd.stopHint.en: Return to the campaign list. This does not pause or stop a running campaign.
rd.stopHint.zh: 返回广告活动列表，不会暂停或停止正在投放的活动。

rd.analyticsLink.en: Attributed revenue in TikTok revenue & audience
rd.analyticsLink.zh: 在 TikTok 收入与观众中查看可归因收入
